data.exact_reserve_text: Claims incurred, net of reinsurance, totalled GBP 308.2 million during the calendar year (2014: GBP 257.2 million). This includes an amount of GBP 33.6 million in respect of increases to reserves on 2013 and prior underwriting years (2014: GBP 26.8 million in respect of reserve releases from 2012 and prior underwriting years).

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate shows a small net gross prior-year release (approximately GBP 2.0m) on underwriting years 2013 and earlier based on the gross claims development table, driven by mixed movements across older years. Management narrative also references a significant prior-year item (~GBP 33.6m) and a GBP 34.7m profit attributable to business inherited via the 2012 reinsurance-to-close, indicating favourable prior-year outcomes and some reinsurance-related effects. The movement appears driven by favourable claims development and benign natural catastrophe experience, together with reinsurance to close impacts.
raw_causal_phrases: comparatively benign natural catastrophe claims experience

data.data_quality_notes: Gross prior-year development computed from the gross claims development triangle (page 36) yields a small net release (~GBP 2.0m). However, narrative and other notes reference a much larger GBP 33.6m movement (described inconsistently across sections as a release or an increase) and a GBP 34.7m profit related to business inherited via the 2012 reinsurance-to-close. Reinsurance-to-close activity and differing narrative language create ambiguity between gross triangle-derived movement and management's described prior-year items. Per-line LOB movements are not quantified in the report.
